name: scenario
value: Are management changes improving service delivery?

name: method
value: Two groups observed before and after an intervention. The arithmetic compares their changes, measured in percentage points (pp). Causal interpretation requires credible identification, including parallel trends.

name: formula
value: Treated change = treated endline − baseline; comparison change = comparison endline − baseline; DiD = treated change − comparison change; counterfactual = treated baseline + comparison change.

name: limits
value: There are no observations, uncertainty intervals or parallel-trend diagnostics. Arithmetic alone establishes no causal effect. Extreme inputs can produce an infeasible counterfactual outside 0–100%; the chart displays and flags that result without silently clipping it.
